mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.scenario_id, r.label, r.priority, r.enabled, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM chat_recommendation r JOIN scenario s ON s.id = r.scenario_id JOIN scenario_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE r.enabled = TRUE AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_id IS NOT NULL AND c.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY r.priority, r.id
